# Agentic power user

## How to use

- Find the situation or symptom below; open only the reference file it names.
- In that file, match a Signal of Violation or Anti-pattern; follow its anchor.
- Fix the input, not the output: name the page that owns the cause.
- Prefer a check or gate over stronger wording.
- Cite every claim as `[Title#anchor](url)` plus the source commit you fetched.
- No match: say "model judgment"; never invent a SHRINE citation.
- Advise on the system (harness, repo, checks), not on the person.

## By symptom ([source](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/overview/#if-you-see-x-read-y))

| Symptom | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Fixing output takes longer than writing it | [Delegation Fit](references/delegation-fit.md) |
| Same correction, again and again | [Correction Diagnosis](references/correction-diagnosis.md) |
| Wrong format or style | [Few-Shot Examples](references/few-shot-examples.md), [Structured Output](references/structured-output.md) |
| Plausible code that does not run | [Verification Loops](references/verification-loops.md) |
| Diffs too large to review | [Reviewable Output](references/reviewable-output.md) |
| Solved the wrong problem | [Problem Before Prescription](references/problem-before-prescription.md), the [Delegation Fit brief](references/delegation-fit.md); long runs: [Spec, Then Build](references/spec-then-build.md) |
| Long run drifts or loses the thread | [Context Handoff](references/context-handoff.md), [Progress Breadcrumbs](references/progress-breadcrumbs.md) |
| Agent took an irreversible action unasked | [Checkpoint Gates](references/checkpoint-gates.md) |
| Shallow answers on hard steps | [Chain of Thought](references/chain-of-thought.md), [Step-Level Routing](references/step-level-routing.md) |
| Confident answers about your own data that are wrong | [RAG](references/rag.md) |
| A prompt change broke something that worked | [Prompt Regression Testing](references/prompt-regression.md) |

## North Star

| Situation | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Maximize value per win, where a win costs tokens plus human attention. | [North Star: TTV (Tokens to Value)](references/tokens-to-value.md) |

## Principles

| Situation | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Decisions follow a fixed precedence: Org > Client > Team > Role > Individual. | [Authority Cascade](references/authority-cascade.md) |
| Pattern predictability reduces tokens more than prompt optimization. | [Consistency as Leverage](references/consistency-as-leverage.md) |
| Stay current by owner, cadence, and pre-agreed tripwires, not by drift. | [Deliberate Currency](references/deliberate-currency.md) |
| Design AI systems for failure, not just success. | [Fail Fast, Recover Smart](references/fail-fast-recover-smart.md) |
| Define where human judgment is required, and make those checkpoints fast. | [Human in the Loop](references/human-in-the-loop.md) |
| Present the problem and constraints, explore solutions, then commit. | [Problem Before Prescription](references/problem-before-prescription.md) |
| Choose the reproducibility level each part needs, and build the mechanisms to hit it. | [Reproducibility](references/reproducibility.md) |

## Patterns

| Situation | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Using a second model or agent to challenge and verify output. | [Adversarial Review](references/adversarial-review.md) |
| Get reasoning before conclusions: a reasoning setting on models that think, a prompt instruction on models that don't. | [Chain of Thought](references/chain-of-thought.md) |
| Stop an agent before irreversible actions and hand the human a decision that clears in one step. | [Checkpoint Gates](references/checkpoint-gates.md) |
| Carry a run across compactions and sessions with a written handoff, not a transcript. | [Context Handoff](references/context-handoff.md) |
| Trace each correction to the input that caused it, and fix that input instead of the output. | [Correction Diagnosis](references/correction-diagnosis.md) |
| Decide per task whether to delegate, pair, or write by hand, and brief delegated work in one message. | [Delegation Fit](references/delegation-fit.md) |
| When agents find better paths, propose improvements back to the system through review. | [Discovery Propagation](references/discovery-propagation.md) |
| Validate by using your own output. | [Dogfooding](references/dogfooding.md) |
| Guide output format and style with concrete examples. | [Few-Shot Examples](references/few-shot-examples.md) |
| Improving output through successive passes. | [Iterative Refinement](references/iterative-refinement.md) |
| Build repeatable structure once, fill with context each time. | [Mechanical Scaffolding](references/mechanical-scaffolding.md) |
| Running the same task across multiple models and comparing results. | [Multi-Model Consensus](references/multi-model-consensus.md) |
| Chain stages with explicit contracts and a gate at every handoff. | [Pipeline Orchestration](references/pipeline-orchestration.md) |
| Record an agent's progress on a shared work board, not in the chat. | [Progress Breadcrumbs](references/progress-breadcrumbs.md) |
| Detect when prompt changes break existing behavior. | [Prompt Regression Testing](references/prompt-regression.md) |
| Ground responses in retrieved context. | [RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)](references/rag.md) |
| Shape delegated code and documents so a human can review them against intent, not from scratch. | [Reviewable Output](references/reviewable-output.md) |
| Have the model evaluate its own output against criteria. | [Self-Critique](references/self-critique.md) |
| Agree a written spec and reviewed plan before an agent executes. | [Spec, Then Build](references/spec-then-build.md) |
| Route each step inside an agent trajectory to a model tier and reasoning effort. | [Step-Level Routing](references/step-level-routing.md) |
| Force output into a defined schema. | [Structured Output](references/structured-output.md) |
| Split independent work across subagents that read widely and return compact results. | [Subagent Fanout](references/subagent-fanout.md) |
| Match each task to the smallest model tier that reliably succeeds. | [Task Routing](references/task-routing.md) |
| Launch an agent to work for hours without a human watching each step. | [Unattended Runs](references/unattended-runs.md) |
| Generate, run a check, and repair until it passes or a stop condition fires. | [Verification Loops](references/verification-loops.md) |
